title: Dunajec Gorge
lead: A park on the Polish-Slovak border. Trzy Korony, Sokolica, and the Dunajec gorge — one of the most beautiful landscapes in Europe.
body:
A Park on the Border

Pieniny National Park is one of the most beautiful national parks in Poland. It lies on the Polish-Slovak border, protecting the Pieniny — a small mountain range famous for one of the most beautiful river gorges in Europe. The Dunajec gorge — as it is called — is the showcase of the park and one of the most recognizable landscapes in Poland.

The park is not only the gorge but also the peaks — Trzy Korony (982 m) and Sokolica (747 m). Trzy Korony is the highest peak of the Pieniny, from which a panorama opens up over the Tatras, Beskid Sądecki, and the Dunajec gorge. Sokolica is famous for its characteristic pine growing at the very summit.

Dunajec Rafting

The biggest attraction of the park is Dunajec rafting — on rafts led by raftsmen in traditional highland costumes. The trip takes about 2–3 hours and leads through the most beautiful fragments of the gorge. The raftsmen tell legends and anecdotes, and the views are unforgettable.

It is also worth stopping in Szczawnica — a spa at the foot of the Pieniny, with a beautiful promenade, mineral water pump room, and numerous guesthouses. It is an ideal base for hikes in the park.
tip: Book the Dunajec rafting in advance — in season spots run out quickly. It is also worth going to Trzy Korony at sunrise — the view is then unforgettable.
